technical.summary: AEP shows bullish structure with price above key moving averages and positive MACD, but overbought oscillators, weak ADX trend strength, and volume confirmation gaps limit swing entry conviction.

fundamental.summary: AEP shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 44 days present material risk with no offsetting smart money support.

sentiment.summary: No actionable sentiment signal for AEP; congressional activity is minimal and dated, market fear/greed is neutral, and news data unavailable.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (206.6) indicates extreme market stress, CPI event in 2 days adds near-term volatility; utilities defensive but credit-sensitive; earnings in 44 days provides some buffer but overall environment highly unfavourable.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above 200-EMA with supertrend bullish and MACD positive provides structural upside bias, supported by proximity to support level 85.58 offering defined risk entry.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought oscillators (Stoch, Williams %R, StochRSI), zero volume confirmation, weak ADX trend strength, severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels), high earnings risk in 44 days, and complete absence of fundamental/smart money support make this a high-risk, low-conviction entry into deteriorating conditions.

decision.entry_rationale: AEP shows bullish technical structure (price above 200-EMA, supertrend positive) but entry conviction is severely undermined by overbought oscillators, zero volume confirmation, and complete absence of fundamental or smart money support.
decision.primary_risk: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels 206.6, CPI event in 2 days) combined with high earnings risk in 44 days and overbought technicals create asymmetric downside risk in a deteriorating environment.
